steps.content: [Black Screen]
The moment you sink into the mire, your mind is invaded by a cacophony of frenzied whispers and shrieks.
These howling forms surge toward you, scattering in panic when your shackles blast them back, only to coalesce and attack again with renewed fury.
You fight them off, forcing your eyes to stay open against the oppressive tide, as you search desperately for any trace of Hilda.
Finally, you see a single code strip, drifting just out of reach. You lunge for it, only to find it too far away.
(Shackles)

Your shackles snap forward, snagging the strip. You clutch it in your hand, a tangible anchor in the chaos, and with a final, desperate effort, you swim with all your might toward the abyssal depths where she vanished.
[Scene Change: Black Background with Light]
Swaying, rocking... "her" consciousness is carried deeper into the abyss.
The cause worth fighting for is gone. The future worth believing in has vanished. What reason is left to struggle? Perhaps to simply cease... is the only peace left.
But then, through the chaos, someone, stubborn and relentless, keeps running toward her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand your pain. I respect your anger. But I will not be controlled by hatred.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Some truths don't need to be laid bare to be understood. I've told you before, I'm not the kind of interrogator who has to uncover every truth at any cost.

options: Pulling her out of the mire

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you want redemption... if you really want to change something, then you have to live. Walk out of here and do what matters. Letting the Mania consume you in this place changes nothing.
He has seen through your torn heart and despair, your ugliness and hypocrisy, yet still, he offers his hand.
steps.female_content: She has seen through your torn heart and despair, your ugliness and hypocrisy, yet still, she offers her hand.

steps.content: Those are his memories, his future, the ones he loves who never yield. And now, he wishes to share them with you.
steps.female_content: Those are her memories, her future, the ones she loves who never yield. And now, she wishes to share them with you.

steps.content: In that future, one you have never reached, you finally see a glimmer of a light worth chasing.
If... If that is so...
Then what does it matter if this body is already scarred by a thousand wounds? Let it burn one last time.
Even if, in the end, only ashes remain.

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: <size=52>DON'T LET THEM WIN! HILDA!!</size>
[Black Background with Light]
If anything remains for her to believe in now...
Perhaps it is nothing more, and nothing less, than the person standing before her.
(CG: Hand Reaching Out)
She reaches for you with a desperate, trembling hand, her eyes holding the hope of one in hell gazing up at a single spider's thread.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Can I... really...?
She offers no resistance. A soft, crimson glow kindles in her palm—its former sharpness gone, the threat dissipated.
From the other end of the shackles, you feel the turbulent Mania within her gradually still.
[Background - Black Ark]
You haul yourself from the churning sludge, Hilda in your arms.
Above, a torrential downpour of black, Mania-saturated rain threatens to scour the world clean, swelling into an apocalyptic flood.
The small manor stands as the last ark, but its walls are already groaning, being swallowed by the encroaching Mania.
The wooden door panel you've claimed as a raft groans in protest, its splintering frame barely keeping you afloat in the muck.

Then, the waves themselves begin to change. The tide of Mania coalesces into physical nightmares, howling as they rise from the depths. Their voices are all too clear, a cacophony of piercing whispers that claw at your mind and throb behind your eyes.
They surge forward, tearing across the water's surface, walking atop the pitch-black splashes as if the waves were solid ground.
[Shackles Red Glow]
Gritting your teeth, you drag Hilda fully onto the unstable platform. The door lurches violently, and for a heart-stopping moment, you teeter on the brink of falling back into the abyss.

Suddenly, a code strip whips out, wrapping around your torso and yanking you back to relative safety. Hilda, now conscious, wipes the stinging rainwater from her eyes and binds the strip tightly around both your wrists.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Let me handle it.
She pivots to confront the colossal wave of Mania.
Monsters are caught in the surge, their snarls swallowed as countless souls churn and compress within Mania. They merge together, coalescing into a towering, vaguely "human" form.
It faces Hilda, and a massive maw splits open, revealing a writhing, nightmarish pit filled with countless lashing tongues.

steps.speaker: Howling Whisper
steps.content: Don't think you're accepted! He's just using you! He'll discard you like trash when he's done!
steps.female_content: Don't think you're accepted! She's just using you! She'll discard you like trash when she's done!

steps.speaker: Bewildered Whisper
steps.content: Just like how you used us!! You made our ideals and beliefs utterly worthless!

steps.speaker: Cursing Whisper
steps.content: Don't think your blood is now clean. Every life you've taken will haunt you to the ends of the earth.

steps.speaker: Resounding Whisper
steps.content: WE WILL NEVER FORGIVE!
Hilda stands in silence, a still point in the storm. She lets them scream, lets them wail, allowing their endless hatred and rage to exhaust itself against her calm.
Her code strip whips through the wind, like a red line slashing the dark. It wraps the giant beast in a searing embrace.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I don't need your forgiveness. I don't care if I'm being used. If there is a chance, I will take it.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I've never found the right path anyway. The worst that can happen is being fooled again, losing myself once more. But I'm used to it now. I'm not afraid anymore.
Her voice cuts softly through the storm, yet it rings with unmistakable clarity. The giant beast thrashes with renewed desperation, as if it can feel its impending doom.
The code strip pulls taut in this desperate tug-of-war. It's a race against annihilation. Will the beast be shredded first, or will Hilda's power shatter under the strain?
Just as Hilda presses her hand against the scar on her throat, ready to break her own limits—
Your hand closes over hers.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't face this alone. We made a promise to leave this place together.
A red glow erupts from your shackles, merging with Hilda's power to form a colossal net that strikes the beast, ensnaring it completely.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I want to see the new DisCity... see the new Fraser... see what has become of my ruined homeland...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I still wish to pursue that ideal... for all of us.

The code strip lashes out, tearing faint traces of memory from the souls. The fragments flicker like dying embers before surging back into Hilda. She shudders slightly, her body jolting like a piece of driftwood struck by a wave.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I accept every one of your curses. Your rage and resentment... I will carry them all.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I have nothing left. Before I leave... it is fitting that you provide me with this burden to bear.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I will carry the weight of the past... but I swear... I will not be crushed by it again.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: And now, if you still stand in my way, I understand why, but I will not yield!
The code strip snaps taut. Empowered by your shackles, it explodes outward, slicing the massive beast apart in an instant. The monstrosity collapses like a felled mountain.
The fragments scatter. Some howl toward you in a vengeful tide. Others flee, wounded, into the distance. The rest simply vanish on the wind.
The cacophony of battle dims, from a roar to a whisper, from a whisper to a murmur, and then into deep, profound silence.
The last few fragments stagger forth in a stubborn, final charge, but the moment they touch Hilda, they transform into harmless motes of flowing light, extinguished against her unwavering presence.
(Small CG - Clearing Skies)
The sky clears at last.
Strength utterly spent, you both collapse to the ground, unable to stand.
Hilda tilts her face toward the sun, a stranger after so long. The light filters through the dissipating clouds, warm and gentle on her skin.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...It was always raining at the manor. I'd nearly forgotten... what a clear sky looked like.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: So... when it clears, the clouds do part.
Sunlight pierces the dark veil, bathing the rain-soaked ruins in a soft, golden glow. The distant sea grows still, its surface calming as if the raging Mania had never been.
...No. Some traces remain.
Her gaze falls to your hands, still bound by the code strip. Quietly, she loosens the knot.
[Laboratory]
(CG: Tank - Eyes Closed)
The liquid in the tank stirs with a soft current.
(CG: Tank - Eyes Open)
She opens her eyes, and her tender gaze finds yours.
With sound trapped by the barrier between you, she raises her hand. Her fingertips press against the glass and begin to move, tracing the familiar patterns of a code she once taught you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Good morning, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Is the sky clear today?
